verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents genuine autonomous background automation: Scheduled Flags that auto-apply changes at a future time without manual intervention, and Release Pipelines that auto-progress flags through stages via triggers/actions, plus audit-log webhooks for streaming events. This covers rule-based automation but isn't framed as AI-agent-driven; the MCP server lets an AI agent script flag changes, but there's no evidence of AI-native agents configuring or monitoring these autonomous pipelines end-to-end, nor independent corroboration of the automation working reliably in production. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of scheduled flags or release pipelines in production, explicit AI-agent-orchestrated automation workflows beyond the MCP API access.
